//: Maps env var name (left, what code reads) → vault key (right, what's stored). Loaded by ../hadoku_site/scripts/secrets/dev-vault.mjs. NO secrets in this file — only the mapping.
//operator-use: These are for operator-side commands run from this repo (force-scrape, etc.), distinct from the production wrapper at hadoku_site/services/pm2/tenhands-wrapper.mjs which has its own TENHANDS_* mappings for the worker process.
//hadoku-task: Board API credential for services/task_board.py. Deliberately mapped to the EXISTING TENHANDS_ADMIN_KEY rather than a new secret: edge-router derives the request tier from SERVICE_KEYS array membership (authGate.ts resolveCallerTier -> X-Hadoku-Tier), and that key is already a SERVICE_KEYS member, so it already gets the 600/min service bucket. A second key would add a secret to rotate without narrowing blast radius — both would live in the same process on the same host.
